items.text: Among the 14 general surgery residents in the 2027 to 2028 academic year, is taking part in monthly video review coaching associated with a larger gain in blinded global rating scale score for laparoscopic cholecystectomy from the start to the end of the year?
items.population: General surgery residents in one programme
items.intervention: Monthly video review coaching with a consultant
items.comparator: Residents who do not take part
items.outcome: Change in blinded global rating scale score (5 to 25)

finer: Feasible with filming already in place and two volunteer coaches; interesting to the programme; novel only locally; ethical if videos are kept out of assessment; relevant to consultant time.
summary: One PECO question with a blinded skill score.
